lifecycle_governance.failure_policy: Retain resources for debugging up to 24 hours default TTL (maximum 168h extension with documented owner and reason). Never destroy failed staging immediately.
lifecycle_governance.success_policy: Retain verified staging resources in clean state awaiting production blue-green rollout and postdeploy closeout (ODP-POSTDEPLOY-WATCH-CLOSEOUT-001) before final destruction.
lifecycle_governance.cleanup_targeting_rule: Destructive cleanup operates ONLY via exact label matching (release_id, ephemeral=true, tenant); broad wildcards and namespace wipes are strictly forbidden.
lifecycle_governance.orphan_scanner_status: Orphan scanner verified active; hourly scanning detects expired TTL and alerts without colliding with active release leases.
